public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int MOD = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        int[] DP = new int[N];
        int[] Cum = new int[N + 1];
        DP[0] = 1;
        Cum[1] = 1;

        for (int i1 = 1; i1 < N; i1++) {

            for (int j = 2; j <= N; j++) {
                long prod = (long) i2 * j;
                if (prod > N) break;

                int idx1 = (int) (N - prod + 1);
                int idx2 = (int) (N - prod - j + 1);
                int maxIdx = Math.max(0, idx2);

                int diff = (Cum[idx1] - Cum[maxIdx] + MOD) % MOD;
                Value = (Value + diff) % MOD;
            }

            Cum[i1 + 1] = (int) ((Cum[i1] + Value) % MOD);
            DP[i1] = (int) Value;
        }

        System.out.println(DP[N - 1]);
    }
}
